refractory.meaning: evidence of contamination or collision; never an identity by itself

amplitudeDrift.meaning: evidence of waveform amplitude drift; never an identity by itself

propagation.meaning: simultaneous multi-channel propagation is evidence; cluster number is not identity

identityMatch.meaning: match stable units across versions by event-set overlap, not label

window.meaning: window change recomputes only intersecting clusters

conflict.keep: both adopted and rejected results retained
